description: This file defines a PHP class named InboundEmailViewEdit that extends the ViewEdit class. It contains a method 'display' which assigns a variable indicating whether the current user is an admin and then calls the parent display method. The file includes licensing and copyright information pertaining to SuiteCRM and SugarCRM.

classes.name: InboundEmailViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit that manages the editing view for inbound email configurations, with custom display behavior.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to assign an 'is_admin' variable based on the current user's admin status, then calls the parent display method.
